cover.concept: A single glowing orange map-pin shape standing on the flat silhouette of a storefront, but faintly visible beneath that storefront, rendered in thin washed-out indigo linework, is the ghost outline of a different, older storefront shape half-erased underneath it — like one signal quietly overwriting another without ever fully disappearing.

inline.name: duplicate-listings
inline.concept: Two nearly identical flat map-pin shapes overlapping at the base, one rendered solid in bright accent orange and the other as a faint outline in muted indigo directly behind it and slightly offset, with a thin crack or split line running between them down to a single shared circular base, as if one pin is quietly draining strength from the other.

inline.name: nap-alignment
inline.concept: A row of four simple rectangular tile shapes of slightly different sizes and misaligned heights, in muted indigo, being nudged by a single geometric hand shape into becoming perfectly even and aligned, with the one tile that snaps into place glowing bright accent orange as it settles into the row.
